name: premiere-pro-full-mcp
description: Local-first Adobe Premiere Pro MCP: 354 flat tools over a dual-track CEP + HMAC-authenticated UXP bridge. No external account, approval envelope, or actionId.

interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to the local Premiere Pro Full MCP bridge over persistent loopback CEP and HMAC-authenticated UXP channels. UXP unlocks frame capture, video transitions, clip move/remove/trim, effects, and track mute. Every operation is its own flat tool (set_active_sequence, add_to_timeline, split_clip, export_frame, ...). No external account, approval envelope, or hidden actionId.
